name: Guide
description: Guide is a starter unit that every player gets when first joining the game. He is a fast attacker with low damage input and have decent range. He is good against an enemy with low defense. He can be a good DPS dealer with his high number of placement.

name: Dye Trader
description: Dye Trader is one of the three starter unit options you obtain by clearing any act in any difficulty. He is a short ranged, fast attacker with low damage input. He is good against slow enemy and with his defense penetration, he can do considerably well against an enemy with defense.

name: Painter
description: Painter is one of the three starter unit options obtained by clearing any forest act in any difficulty. He is a long ranged, slow but heavy damage dealer. He is useful against an enemy with large amount of health, a high defense enemy and a fast enemy.

name: Demolitionist
description: Demolitionist is one of the three starter unit options you obtain by clearing any forest act in any difficulty. He is a medium ranged unit, having considerably high damage input with splash. He is useful against crowds of enemies.

name: Finch Staff
description: Finch Staff is a unit that has a chance to obtained from clearing Act 1-3 of the Forest biome on Classic-Expert difficulty. They are a long ranged unit, having decent attack speed with low damage input. They are useful against fast enemy with low defense.

name: Slime Staff
description: Slime Staff is a rare unit obtained as a rare drop from slime enemies, and King Slime Treasure Bag (2%). They are fast but low damage dealer with splash, with some equipment set up, they can be pretty good for early game defense with their cheap cost.

name: Slime Prince
description: Slime Prince is a unit exclusively obtained in Act 3 of the Forest on Master. He is a medium ranged unit, having a very good cost efficiency and area of splash, making him amazing for early game defense.

name: Suspicious Eye
description: Suspicious Eye is a unit exclusively obtained in Act 6 of the Forest on Master. They are an insanely fast attacker for low amount of damage but can only attack one enemy at the time as they're locks onto their target until it die. They can be very powerful against the boss and high health enemy with some equipment setup.

name: Volt Bunny
description: Volt Bunny is a unit that can obtained from clearing Act+ of Forest biome. They are a medium ranged unit. They have an ability to create 2-3 chains of electric against enemies, making them limited crowds control unit. They're very cheap to be placed and upgrade, as such they're potentially be amazing as an early game defense unit.

name: Zoologist
description: Zoolist is a unit that can obtained from Completing 50% of Forest Enemy Bestiary. She is a summoner, allow her to spawn a bunny from the map exit that move toward to the map entrance. She can be an amazing unit against high health but slow enemy since she will always be a constant DPS against the enemy for the entirety of map path length. However she may struggles on a map with multiple paths.

name: Star Merchant
description: Star Merchant is an Achievement unit, rewarding the player for obtaining Gold Forest badge by completed Act 1-6 of Forest on all difficulties. They are an economy that generate huge amount of mana, but very slowly. They are recommended for an Act with a long duration of waves and an Act with a boss.
override_notes: Verified in-game by Jolt (missing on board) | Economy unit - fixed at Lv 1 (Jolt)

name: Desert Acolyte
description: Desert Acolyte is a unit dropped from clearing a match in Desert Acts. They have no mana cost for placement and have low DMG and decently fast attack speed. They can be good for early game with good reforgement and equipments.

name: Bast Statue
description: Bast Statue is a unit obtained from Oasis Crate (10%). It is a full AoE ranged unit that deals damage to the 20 first enemies inside its range. It can be useful against crowds of enemies, with its high damage it can chipped down high health enemy to have them killed by another unit. It also have very high defense penetration, as such high defense enemy is also not a problem. Recommended giving it a SPA stats buffs.

name: Storm Cloud
description: Storm Cloud is a unit exclusively obtained in Act 3 of Desert on Master. They are a very powerful unit that can dealt devastating amount of damage against enemy, however they are also attack very slowly. It is best to use them against an enemy with very high health, high defense and may have slow walkspeed.

name: Golfer
description: Golfer is a unit that has a chance to to be obtained from clearing Act 4 of the Desert biome. He is a medium ranged unit. He have an ability to chain his projectile across the enemy, making him a semi-crowds control unit. He is rather on expensive side though, it is recommended to place him before start upgrading.

name: Baby Ghost Bell
description: Baby Ghost Bell is a unit exclusively obtained in Act 5 of the Desert on Master. They are a slow attacker with low amount of DMG. They can also inflict Confusion on the enemy with duration of 2 seconds. They could stall an enemy decently as a support unit. Though they're rather expensive to be used.

name: Digtoise
description: Digtoise is an Achievement unit, rewarding the player for obtaining Gold Desert badge by completed Act 1-5 of Desert on all difficulties. They're a single-target unit with good damage input and decently fast attack speed. They have the "Percentage" stats that made them deals more damage toward high health enemy. Their placement stats have rather low range but gradually get bigger when upgraded. Their cost-efficiency is rather very good, It is recommended to be use against the boss and high health enemy.

name: Baby Dinosaur
description: Baby Dinosaur is a unit that have a chance to obtained from extracting Desert Fossil via using Extractinator. They are rather unique unit since they have an ability to deal an area of damage in cone shape. It is very expensive to be used, so it is recommended to be use alongside with economy unit.

name: Flinx
description: Flinx is a unit that can be obtained from clearing Snow Act 2 or a drop from Snow Flinx. It is a low damaging unit that have an ability to deal percentage damage just like Digtoise, however at 2% of enemy's max health. It can be used as a cheap high damaging chip unit against a high health enemy in some circumstances.

name: Snow Launcher
description: Snowball Launcher is a unit dropped from clearing a match in Act 1 of Snow. It is a single-target unit that have slightly low damage, fast attack and medium range. It can be used as a damage dealer since it have quite considerably good DPS, and due to its high base damage on the max upgrade, getting defense penetration may not be needed if using a correct setup.

name: Chester
description: Chester is a unit exclusively obtained in Act 4 of Snow on Master. They're a slow attacker with massive damage input, with pretty low range. They can used as a nuker against high health enemy for the short amount of time, although not quite an impressive unit as it gets outclassed by some other units.

name: Houndius Shootius
description: Houndius Shootius is an Achievement unit, rewarding the player for obtaining Gold Snow badge by completed Act 1-4 of Snow on all difficulties. They're a semi-single target unit that can shoot multiple pellets at the enemies, like a shotgun. The pellet is shoot spread range that allow the pellet projectile to travel in the large area, hence may or may not hitting multiple targets. Their base damage input was rather low, so bringing some defense penetration equipments would help it a lot. Lastly, They were recommended to be placed as close to the path as possible for their potential.

name: Merchant
description: Merchant is a unit that can be purchase for 1,000 coins from Market. He is an economy unit, generate low amount of manas at fast speed. He is recommended for an Act with a long duration of waves and an Act with a boss.

name: Vampire Frog
description: Vampire Frog is a unit that can be crafted with 40 Chum Bucket(s), 7 Bloody Tear(s), 30 Worm(s), and 85 Salmon(s). Their attack can increased the base HP to 100% of the maximum health per placement. Due to their high damage input, they are very good against an enemy with high defense and a slow enemy. However they are very expensive to be used, in some circumstance it will be an amazing pick as a DPS.

name: Tiny Deerclops
description: Tiny Deerclops is a unit that can be crafted with 45 Boreal Wood(s), Deerclops Eyeball, Eye Bone, Eyebrella, and 30 Flinx Fur(s). They are a heavy hitter with high DMG, slow attack speed and big area of splash. When they're max upgraded, they will launch two attacks for every attack, doubled their base DPS in the process. They're especially powerful against crowds of enemies. Although their only problem was being expensive to use and having one placement limit, but they're still a powerful individually regardless.

name: Zephyr Fish
description: Zephyr Fish is a unit that have a very rare chance of being fished up via fishing, have a pity of 2000 catches for the guarantee chance of being fished up. They are a medium ranged tower that shoot projectile that have an area of splash and have considerably high damage input, however they're weak against an enemy with high value of defense. They are very good against crowds of enemies, and against high health enemy, however they are very expensive to use and not as effective against high defense enemy.
override_notes: Enemy defense reduces Zephyr Fish hits by 5x (10 DEF = -50 per hit) - Jolt

name: Black Cat
description: Black Cat is an event unit obtained from Goodie Bag. They are a sub-dps and support unit that can inflict Bad Luck status effect against the enemy. They can be used as a support that help boosting the damage input of main DPS units during the match, although some specific setup may be needed.

name: Squashling
description: Squashling is an event unit that can be obtained by buying from the Market for 300 Pumpkin(s). It doesn't do any damage but have an ability to collect the enemy's dropped item within their range on each of their "attack".
